:::{#def-epe}
#### Expected prediction error at a covariate value

The **expected prediction error at $\predvar$**
(**EPE**; also the **expected squared prediction error**, **ESPE**)
of a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted = \fitmodf{\trainset}$
is the [expected value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) of its squared [prediction error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-error)
$\prederr_{*}\paren{\fitted} = \predvalf{\newpredvar} - \newoutvar$
at a [new observation](#def-new-observation) with $\newpredvar = \predvar$.
The fitted model comes from a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$
applied to a random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$ of $\nobs$ [observations](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-observation),
drawn independently of $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$,
so the fitted model is random.
The expected value is taken over $\trainset$ and over $\newoutvar$,
so its value depends on $\fitproc$ and $\nobs$:

$$
\epe{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\predvar} \eqdef \E{\prederr_{*}\paren{\fitmodf{\trainset}}^2 \mid \newpredvar = \predvar}.
$$ {#eq-epe}

:::
